fusions.name: Inexorable Drag
fusions.desc: A slow heavy blow that deals 28 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Drowsy Ripple
fusions.desc: Sends a ripple that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Hindered], slowing the target's attacks for 5 seconds. It costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Held Stillness
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Arrives Eventually
fusions.desc: After a long run without a critical hit, your critical chance rises 50% for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
